what: crates/tt/src/lib.rs token_to_literal (~line 530): a quoted literal with a suffix (`'c'u32`, `"s"x`, `b'b'_suff`) becomes LitKind::Err with the whole text; rustc lexes it as Char/Str/Byte with the suffix and refuses the suffix later in the parser/lowering. Replace the ill-suffixed arm with `suffix => Literal::new(lit, span, kind, suffix)` for quoted kinds (numbers keep the current arm: their text_and_suffix is the token text). Fails syntax-bridge lexing_then_parsing_gives_the_files_tree on parser test_data 0030_string_suffixes.rs (the tt-built parser input disagrees with the lexer on those tokens). Check callers that relied on Err for suffixed quoted literals (mbe/proc-macro-srv Display) once built.
